name: antigravity-pilot
description: Cross-platform desktop computer use and parallel virtual desktops for Google Antigravity (Windows, macOS & Linux): headless accessibility automation, zero-dependency Set-of-Mark overlays, deterministic Risk-Guard + JSONL audit traces, parameterized recipes, and <1s live noVNC Docker sandboxes — with zero MCP token bloat.
suggestedPrompts: Check desktop automation readiness across my OS with pilot_ctl.py doctor and capture a Set-of-Mark --annotate screenshot of my active app
List my saved desktop recipes with pilot_ctl.py recipe list and run a --dry-run Risk-Guard preview before executing
Spin up an isolated virtual Linux desktop sandbox with sandbox_ctl.py up desk-1 --vnc and return its live noVNC URL
